title: 第36章 凶猛无双四皇子！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 宁川也是脸色铁青，在原地一连转了三圈。妈的，丢人丢大发了啊！人被抓回来，核查半天都没有发现问题，还准备将人放了。结果唐逸这家伙只是看了两眼，就从细节确定了吴勇的身份。“带下去，连夜突审，把他知道的都给我撬出来。”宁川冷声道：“在他明天的保人来之前，我要知道所有信息。”唐逸暗暗点头，现在抓吴勇的保人，只会打草惊蛇。但留给他们的时间也只有一个晚上，明日吴勇的保人过来，该暴露的也会暴露。“兔崽子，装逼装够了没？”宁川一把拎着唐逸的后脖颈，拖着他就往甬道走：“装够了，就给老子乖乖坐牢去。”妈的，想给这家伙一个下马威，现在却被他下马威了。唐逸无语，能温柔点吗？这么粗暴干嘛！很快，唐逸就被丢进一间牢房中。刚被带进监牢，耳边就有咆哮声传来。“快来人，给老子一点酒，再给老子来点肉。”“老子都快特妈饿扁了，信不信老子出去，弄死你们这些狗奴才。”“……”唐逸听着隔壁牢房传来的怒吼声，中气十足，声音浑厚，就这气势哪里有半点饥饿的样子？再饿他三天估计都没问题。“宁千户，隔壁关的是谁？”宁川就等唐逸发问，道：“隔壁关的是四皇子萧棣，他把强抢民女的宁安侯世子给砍了，被陛下关在隔壁，不给吃喝。”“哦，对了，他砍的那个人，是我弟弟。”唐逸：“？？？”他砍了你弟弟，你还能如此风轻云淡？你们可还真是兄弟情深啊！“兄弟，高阳公主虽然有些刁蛮，但绝对是我大炎最漂亮的公主。”宁川笑着冲着唐逸竖起大拇指，看了眼隔壁，故意大声道：“你这又亲又摸又压的，简直完成了我们男人想干却又不敢干的壮举。”“就冲这一点，我请你喝酒！”唐逸：“？？？”草，这狗贼要害我！果然，隔壁牢房静了一瞬，传来呼啸一般的怒吼！“宁川，你特妈的说什么？”“隔壁的你是谁，你对我妹妹做了什么？老子特妈杀了你！”唐逸愕然地看着宁川，这就是你说的安稳睡一晚？明早放我出北镇抚司？靠！我信了你的邪！“宁千户，这就过分了啊！”唐逸咬牙切齿道。“放心，明日一定会放你出去的……只是横着出去还是竖着出去，看你的造化。”宁川轻笑一声，潇洒转身离去。有多潇洒？潇洒到扭胯的幅度太逆天，腰间的钥匙直接被甩出去。好巧不巧地，钥匙甩隔壁牢房去了。“我草，宁川你大爷！”唐逸见到这一幕顿时脸都绿了，威胁道：“宁千户，你确定要这么玩？你这样玩很容易把路给走窄了啊！”宁川摆了摆手竖了个中指，头也不回走了。陛下让你们一个晚上就得擦出火花！四皇子又不是绝世美女，擦个屁的火花啊！陛下说得对，男人要激情澎湃，有什么比打架更容易磨合感情的吗？只要不打死就行……应该打不死吧？四皇子下手应该有分寸的吧？不管了，陛下不是很看好这小子吗？要是他连在四皇子手上活下来的本事都没有，那就对不起陛下的看重，被打死也是活该。哐当！与此同时，唐逸已经听到隔壁传来锁链落地的声音。显然，四皇子已经将门打开了。他身体陡然紧绷。接着，就看到一个身材魁梧，头发凌乱的青年，双手枕着头拖着一条长长的粗铁链，出现在了脑门前。“就是你小子，非礼我妹妹？”萧棣嘴里叼着稻草，一边扭脖子，一边甩手。拖在身后的锁链在他手中缠绕，形成了一个巨大的铁拳。见到这一幕唐逸眉心直跳，铁链至少一百斤，一般人别说一只手，就是两只手也不一定能提起来。但在他手中竟然跟棉花一样，似乎没有半点重量。是个高手！唐逸顿时全神戒备，道：“不是非礼，我是在救她……”“废话真多！”话没说完，前方青年已经一脚踹开牢门，一拳向着他砸了过来。唐逸脸色骤变，抬手格挡。萧棣的招式很普通，唐逸甚至已经想好了接下来的招了。只要挡住萧棣的拳头，顺势一个过肩摔将其摔出去。结果。轰！他先飞出去了。萧棣看似没有什么力道的拳头，砸在手掌的瞬间，唐逸觉得自己像是被一头奔马撞在身上一样。来不及做任何反应，他当场就被砸飞出去，身体落在两丈开外。霎时间，唐逸只觉得自己整条右臂都碎裂，那种钻心的疼痛让他冷汗直冒。他已经很久，没有感受过这种力度了。只是此时唐逸已经顾不得手上的疼痛了。他抱着右手站起来，看着对面的青年脸色充满忌惮。妈的，他有预感萧棣是个高手，可没想到这么高啊！这特娘的还怎么打？“哟呵，原来不会武功啊！”萧棣铁拳轻轻敲着手掌，看向唐逸的目光有些诧异。没武功敢接他的拳头，胆子不小。难怪敢调戏他妹！可随即，萧棣又怒了。“娘的，不会武功，你也敢调戏我妹？”“老子整死你！”萧棣猛地收拳，一拳再度向唐逸砸了过去。唐逸瞳孔骤缩。这一拳的力道，绝对比刚才那一拳还重。这要是打在他身上，还不得当场骨断筋折？要搁曾经的他，或许还能拼一把。但现在这具身体就像是生锈一般，没有一点灵活性，怎么打？不能硬刚！只能智取。唐逸快步向后退，将萧澜搬出来：“你妹妹患的是肺痨，已经很严重了。”“现在，整个世界就只有我能救她！”萧棣怒笑：“还敢拿我妹妹说事？死！”话音落，拳风直接逼近。“靠！听老子把话说完啊！孔诗岚可以作证，萧策也可以作证！”唐逸大喊。萧棣原本不信的，然而听到萧策两个字，砸向唐逸的拳头猛地偏离了方向。轰的一声，砸在了他身侧的墙上。结果，墙塌了。唐逸看着被打塌的墙，下意识咽了咽口水。错了，这要是打在他身上，不是骨断筋折，是会死。“你、你说什么？你确定你能救我妹妹？”萧棣颤抖着庞大的身躯，小心翼翼问。唐逸无语：“废话！刚刚我说的两人，都可以作证，你不信自己去问！”“哈哈，哈哈哈！好，好好好！”萧棣疯了般大笑，随即甩了甩手，连忙将手上的铁链抖落在地。他冲着唐逸眨了眨眼，带着一丝腼腆道：“咳咳，神医啊，我说刚才这是误会，你信吗？”萧策，那特妈是他爹啊！他爹能作证，他能不信吗？他敢不信吗？！只是唐逸看了一眼隔壁牢房被吓得瑟瑟发抖的犯人……误会？呵呵，我误会你大爷！“我信，这都是误会。”唐逸咬牙，皮笑肉不笑。“对吧，我就说是误会吧。”萧棣抬手揽着唐逸的肩膀，咧着大嘴笑道：“误会归误会，你还是得给我说说你和我妹妹怎么就误会了？”听出萧棣的试探，唐逸将之前在胭脂楼发生的事说了一遍。萧棣听到孔诗岚和宁川都在场，终于完全相信了唐逸的话。孔诗岚是孔太傅的孙女，是澜儿最好的姐妹，唐逸要不是救澜儿，孔诗岚不可能让他近身。宁川，那是父皇的心腹。唐逸要不是救人，早被宁川给砍了。“哎，这误会好啊！误会好……”萧棣咧嘴笑着，眼眶却瞬间通红。他虽然性格大大咧咧，但在对妹妹高阳公主的情感上，却无人可比！高阳跟他是一母同胞的亲姐妹，高阳最崇拜他这个四哥，而他也从小最疼爱妹妹。当初病中的高阳想吃荔枝，他愣是不顾战场归来身上带伤，直率亲卫连续数日奔袭千里至岭南，整整江荔枝给拉来三大车，守在病床前一颗一颗亲手剥给妹妹……萧棣抬手冲着唐逸拱手，无比认真地鞠了一躬，道：“兄弟，多谢你出手救我妹妹，我萧棣欠你一条命！刚刚的事，是我唐突了！”唐逸嘴角微抽。这家伙真是皇子吗？身上没有半点皇子该有的城府和修养，感觉就像是个土匪啊！唐逸拍了拍胸口，道：“刚才被你吓到了。”“没事，我帮你揉揉胸！”“嗯，肩膀有点酸。”“哈哈，我最喜欢捶背了，我帮你捶捶……”“……”廊道外，宁川压着绣春刀带着几个锦衣卫等候在这里，就是等牢房中传来怒吼声和惨叫声，然后好及时冲过去将人分开。结果等了半炷香的时间了，依旧没有任何惨叫声传来。难不成四殿下怒火中烧，失手将唐逸打死了，连惨叫声都没有来得及发出？想到这些宁川脸色微变，立即快步往牢房走去。结果刚刚凑近牢房，宁川和几个锦衣卫，便看到了终生难忘的一幕。唐逸正悠闲地躺在地上，而身份尊贵的四皇子萧棣，正殷勤地给他捶背，甚至……脸上还带着谄媚的笑！这……怎么回事啊？暴躁虎萧棣，就这样被制服了？
content_en: Ning Chuan's face was also ashen and he spun around three times in a row.Damn, I’m so embarrassed!The person was captured and checked for a long time but no problem was found, so he was ready to be released.In the end, Tang Yi only took a few glances and determined Wu Yong's identity from the details."Take him down, interrogate him overnight, and pry out everything he knows." Ning Chuan said coldly: "Before his guarantor comes tomorrow, I want to know all the information." Tang Yi nodded secretly, arresting Wu Yong's guarantor now will only alert the enemy.But they only have one night left. Wu Yong's guarantor will come tomorrow, and those who should be exposed will also be exposed."You bastard, have you had enough pretense?" Ning Chuan grabbed Tang Yi by the scruff of his neck and dragged him toward the corridor: "If you've had enough pretense, just go to jail for me." Damn it, I wanted to give this guy a blow, but now he has given him a blow.Tang Yi was speechless, could you be gentler?Why are you so rude?Soon, Tang Yi was thrown into a cell.As soon as he was brought into the prison, there was a roar in his ears."Come on, come on, give me some wine and some meat." "I'm almost starving. Believe it or not, I'll go out and kill you dog slaves." "..." Tang Yi listened to the roar from the cell next door. He was full of energy and had a deep voice. How could there be any hint of hunger in this momentum?It's probably okay to starve him for another three days."Ning Qianhu, who is being imprisoned next door?" Ning Chuan waited for Tang Yi to ask and said, "The person imprisoned next door is the fourth prince Xiao Di. He beheaded the Ning'an Hou Shizi who raped a common girl. His Majesty imprisoned him next door without food or drink." "Oh, by the way, the person he chopped was my younger brother." Tang Yi: "???" He beheaded your brother, how can you still be so calm?You guys really have a deep brotherhood!"Brother, although Princess Gao Yang is a bit unruly, she is definitely the most beautiful princess in my country." Ning Chuan smiled and gave Tang Yi a thumbs up, glanced at the next door, and said loudly: "You kiss, touch and press, you have accomplished a feat that we men want to do but dare not do." "For this reason, I will treat you to a drink!" Tang Yi: "???" Damn, this thief wants to harm me!Sure enough, the cell next door was silent for a moment, and then there was a roar like a roar!"Ning Chuan, what the hell are you talking about?" "Who are you next door? What did you do to my sister? I'm going to kill you!" Tang Yi looked at Ning Chuan in shock. Is this what you call a peaceful night's sleep?Will you let me out of Beizhen Fusi tomorrow morning?Depend on!I believed your evil deeds!"Ning Qianhu, this is too much!" Tang Yi gritted his teeth."Don't worry, I will definitely let you out tomorrow...it just depends on your luck whether you go out horizontally or vertically." Ning Chuan chuckled, turned around and left.How chic?He was so cool that he twisted his hips so much that the keys from his waist were thrown out.By coincidence, the key slipped into the next cell."Fuck you, Ning Chuan!" Tang Yi turned green when he saw this scene and threatened: "Ning Qianhu, are you sure you want to play like this? You can easily narrow the road by playing like this!" Ning Chuan waved his hand and gave him the middle finger, and left without looking back.His Majesty asked you to create sparks in just one night!The Fourth Prince is not a peerless beauty, she is so sparkly!Your Majesty is right, men need to be full of passion. Is there anything easier to build a relationship than fighting?As long as he doesn't get beaten to death... he shouldn't be beaten to death, right?The fourth prince should be measured in his actions, right?No matter, doesn’t His Majesty think highly of this boy?If he doesn't even have the ability to survive the Fourth Prince's hands, then he is disrespectful to His Majesty and deserves to be beaten to death.Bang!At the same time, Tang Yi had already heard the sound of chains falling to the ground from next door.Apparently, the fourth prince had already opened the door.His body suddenly tensed up.Then, a tall young man with messy hair appeared in front of his head with his hands on his head and a long thick iron chain."Is it you, kid, who molested my sister?" Xiao Di held a straw in his mouth, twisting his neck and shaking his hands.The chains trailing behind him were entangled in his hands, forming a huge iron fist.Seeing this scene, Tang Yi's eyebrows jumped. The chain was at least a hundred pounds. Most people might not be able to lift it with one hand or even two hands.But in his hands it was like cotton, seemingly weightless at all.He is a master!Tang Yi was immediately on guard and said, "It's not an indecent act, I'm trying to save her..." "That's a lot of nonsense!" Before he could finish his words, the young man in front of him kicked open the cell door and punched him.Tang Yi's expression suddenly changed and he raised his hand to block.Xiao Di's moves were very ordinary, and Tang Yi had even thought of the next move.Just block Xiao Di's fist and throw him away with an over-the-shoulder throw.result.boom!He flew out first.The moment Xiao Di's seemingly weak fist hit his palm, Tang Yi felt as if he was hit by a galloping horse.Before he had time to react, he was knocked out on the spot and his body landed two feet away.In an instant, Tang Yi felt that his entire right arm was shattered, and the heartbreaking pain made him break out in a cold sweat.He hasn't felt this kind of strength for a long time.But at this time, Tang Yi could no longer care about the pain in his hands.He stood up with his right hand in his arms and looked at the young man opposite with a fearful expression on his face.Damn, he had a hunch that Xiao Di was a master, but he didn't expect him to be so high!How can I beat this bitch?"Oh, it turns out you don't know martial arts!" Xiao Di tapped his palm lightly with his iron fist and looked at Tang Yi in surprise.If you don't have martial arts skills and dare to take his fist, you are very courageous.No wonder he dared to tease his sister!But then, Xiao Di became angry again."Mom, you don't know martial arts, how dare you tease my sister?" "I'll beat you to death!" Xiao Di suddenly retracted his fist and punched Tang Yi again.Tang Yi's pupils shrank suddenly.The force of this punch was definitely heavier than the one just now.If this hit him, wouldn't his bones and tendons be broken on the spot?If he were to put aside the past, he might still be able to give it a try.But now this body seems to be rusty and has no flexibility at all. How can I fight?Don't be tough!It can only be outsmarted.Tang Yi quickly stepped back and moved Xiao Lan out: "Your sister is suffering from tuberculosis, which is already very serious." "Now, I am the only one in the world who can save her!" Xiao Di laughed angrily: "You dare to make trouble with my sister? Die!" After saying this, the fist wind approached directly."Damn!
